title: I-539A — Supplemental Information for Application to Extend/Change Nonimmigrant Status

sections.preparador: Part 6 — Preparer (if someone filled this out for you)

principal_sobrenome.label: Last name of the principal I-539 applicant
principal_sobrenome.hint: The last name of the person who filed the main I-539 — whose extension/change of status request you're attached to as a dependent (for example, your spouse or a parent). Not your own last name.

principal_nome.label: First name of the principal I-539 applicant
principal_nome.hint: The first name of that same person — who filed the main I-539 (for example, your spouse or a parent). Not your own name.

principal_nome_meio.label: Middle name of the principal applicant (if any)
principal_nome_meio.hint: The middle name of that same person (who filed the main I-539), not your own. Leave blank if they don't have a middle name or you don't know it.

numero_a.label: Alien Registration Number (A-Number, if any)
numero_a.hint: Format A-XXXXXXXXX. Leave blank if you've never received one.

data_chegada.label: Date of your most recent entry into the United States
data_chegada.hint: Find this date in your passport (entry stamp) or on your Form I-94 (i94.cbp.dhs.gov).

numero_i94.label: Your Form I-94 (Arrival-Departure Record) number
numero_i94.hint: Look it up at i94.cbp.dhs.gov using your passport details if you don't have the number on hand.

numero_documento_viagem.label: Travel document number (if different from passport)
numero_documento_viagem.hint: Only fill this in if you entered with a document other than a passport (e.g., a refugee travel document, border crossing card). If you entered with a regular passport, leave it blank.

pais_emissao_passaporte.label: Country that issued the passport/travel document

status_atual.label: Your current nonimmigrant status (exact USCIS code)
status_atual.hint: Use the exact official code, no hyphen (e.g. F2, B2, H4) — the form's internal field calls this "New Status" but it's actually your CURRENT status. Check your Form I-94 if unsure.

data_expiracao_status.label: Expiration date of your current status

passaporte_atual_numero.label: CURRENT passport number (only if different from above)

passaporte_atual_expiracao.label: Current passport expiration date (only if different from above)

passaporte_atual_pais.label: Current passport issuing country (only if different from above)

uscis_online_account.label: Your USCIS online account number (if any)
uscis_online_account.hint: 12 digits, no dashes — found in your account at my.uscis.gov, if you have already created one.

adicional_visto_imigrante.label: Are you an applicant for an immigrant visa?
adicional_visto_imigrante.hint: Having a Green Card process underway can complicate a nonimmigrant extension/change of status request, depending on your current status. Answer honestly; check with the team about how this affects your specific case.

adicional_peticao_ja_protocolada.label: Has an immigrant petition ever been filed for you?
adicional_peticao_ja_protocolada.hint: This includes any Green Card petition (e.g., I-130, I-140) ever filed on your behalf, even if still pending or already denied. Check with the team about how this affects your I-539 request.

adicional_i485_ja_protocolado.label: Have you ever filed a Form I-485 (Adjustment of Status)?
adicional_i485_ja_protocolado.hint: This refers to Form I-485 (Adjustment of Status/Green Card), not the current I-539. Answer honestly even if the I-485 was denied or withdrawn.

adicional_ofensa_criminal.label: Have you ever been arrested or convicted of a crime since your last entry into the U.S.?
adicional_ofensa_criminal.hint: Include ANY arrest, charge, or conviction, even if it was dismissed, pardoned, or never resulted in a conviction — including things that seem minor (e.g., DUI). If you're unsure whether something counts, answer "Yes" and explain in the application; confirm with the team before submitting.

adicional_tortura_genocidio.label: Have you ever ordered, incited, committed, assisted, or otherwise participated in acts of torture or genocide?
adicional_tortura_genocidio.hint: This is one of USCIS's mandatory screening questions about human rights violations (INA 212(a)(3)(E)), asked of everyone — it is not an accusation. Answer honestly; if in doubt, check with the team or an immigration attorney before submitting.

adicional_matar.label: Have you ever ordered, incited, committed, assisted, or otherwise participated in killing any person?
adicional_matar.hint: A standard USCIS screening question about human rights violations asked of every applicant — it doesn't presume anything about you. Answer honestly; if in doubt, check with the team or an immigration attorney.

adicional_lesao_grave.label: Have you ever ordered, incited, committed, assisted, or otherwise participated in intentionally and severely injuring any person?
adicional_lesao_grave.hint: A standard USCIS screening question about human rights violations asked of every applicant. Answer honestly; if in doubt, check with the team or an immigration attorney.

adicional_contato_sexual_forcado.label: Have you ever ordered, incited, committed, assisted, or otherwise participated in nonconsensual or forced sexual contact with any person?
adicional_contato_sexual_forcado.hint: A standard USCIS screening question about human rights violations asked of every applicant. Answer honestly; if in doubt, check with the team or an immigration attorney.

adicional_limitar_religiao.label: Have you ever ordered, incited, committed, assisted, or otherwise participated in limiting or denying anyone's ability to practice their religion?
adicional_limitar_religiao.hint: A standard USCIS screening question about human rights violations asked of every applicant. Answer honestly; if in doubt, check with the team or an immigration attorney.

adicional_grupo_armado.label: Have you ever served in, been a member of, assisted, or participated in any military, paramilitary, police, rebel, guerrilla, militia, or other armed group?
adicional_grupo_armado.hint: A standard USCIS screening question about involvement with armed groups, asked of every applicant — this includes even mandatory military service in your home country. Answer honestly; if in doubt, check with the team or an immigration attorney.

adicional_trabalho_prisao.label: Have you ever worked, volunteered, or served in any prison, detention facility, labor camp, or other place that involved detaining people?
adicional_trabalho_prisao.hint: A standard USCIS screening question about human rights violations asked of every applicant. Answer honestly; if in doubt, check with the team or an immigration attorney.

adicional_ameaca_arma.label: Have you ever been a member of, assisted, or participated in any group where you or others used or threatened to use weapons against any person?
adicional_ameaca_arma.hint: A standard USCIS screening question about human rights violations asked of every applicant. Answer honestly; if in doubt, check with the team or an immigration attorney.

adicional_venda_armas.label: Have you ever sold, provided, or transported weapons, or helped someone do so, knowing or believing they'd be used against another person?
adicional_venda_armas.hint: A standard USCIS screening question about human rights violations asked of every applicant. Answer honestly; if in doubt, check with the team or an immigration attorney.

adicional_treinamento_armas.label: Have you ever received weapons, paramilitary, or other military-type training?
adicional_treinamento_armas.hint: This includes even mandatory military training (compulsory service) in your home country — it doesn't by itself mean anything is wrong. Answer honestly; if in doubt, check with the team or an immigration attorney.

adicional_violou_status.label: Have you ever violated the terms of the nonimmigrant status you currently hold?
adicional_violou_status.hint: Examples: working without authorization, staying longer than allowed under a prior status, or not following your visa's conditions (e.g., studying while on a visitor status). If you're unsure, check with the team before submitting — leaving out a violation can be worse than disclosing it.

adicional_processo_remocao.label: Are you currently in removal (deportation) proceedings?
adicional_processo_remocao.hint: "Removal proceedings" means you've already received an official Notice to Appear in immigration court, not just having had some status issue in the past. If unsure, check with the team.

adicional_ja_trabalhou_eua.label: Have you worked in the United States since you were last admitted or granted an extension/change of status?
adicional_ja_trabalhou_eua.hint: If "No," be ready to explain how you support yourself financially. Working without authorization (including remotely for a company in Brazil) can be considered unauthorized employment.

adicional_visitante_j1j2.label: Are you now, or have you ever been, a J-1 exchange visitor or a J-2 dependent of a J-1 exchange visitor?
adicional_visitante_j1j2.hint: Important: many J-1/J-2 visas carry a 2-year home-country residency requirement before you can change status inside the U.S. (INA 212(e)) — if this applies to you, this I-539 request may not be possible without a waiver. Check with the team before proceeding.

interprete_idioma.label: Language the interpreter is fluent in (besides English)
